The Nintendo Rocky Energy 087/088 Holo and Reverse Holo Rare 2006 Special Energy card is a sought-after collectible for Pokémon TCG fans. This special energy card features a holo finish and belongs to the 2006 set. Manufactured by Nintendo, this English-language card showcases the iconic Pokémon franchise and is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. With its unique design and rarity, this card is a must-have for fans of the Pokémon TCG.
